crossRefs.note: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.”…
The third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families. The border of their inheritance was to…

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: “By the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun, one portion.
translations.bsb: Zebulun will have one portion bordering the territory of Issachar from east to west.
